description: A 3HP random voltage source: a smoothly fluctuating random CV carrying jitter, slow interference and occasional voltage slips, with an attenuverting blend for a second signal

params.text: Shifts the output up or down, -5V fully left, none at centre and +5V fully right
Sets how often a new random target is chosen, one every 100 seconds fully left rising to six a second fully right
Sets the depth of the random voltage before OFFSET is added, none fully left and ±5V fully right
Crossfades the output from the internal random voltage towards the input jack, towards the input inverted when turned anticlockwise, and changes nothing while that jack is unpatched

inputs.text: A second signal for the B knob to crossfade to, with ±5V taken as full scale

outputs.text: The random voltage scaled by RANGE and shifted by OFFSET, clipped at ±10V and always one channel

notes: the output moves on its own with nothing patched at all; the input is there only for the crossfade
two lamps show the sign of the output, green for positive and red for negative, and a yellow one shows the jitter and the voltage slips

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
